p.strong: What can go wrong, and what stops it

div.p: Restore failed, then a save runs → no sentinel, the save is refused. Two containers on one prefix → the second is refused by the lease. A sync deletes the wrong thing → the old object is in .persist-trash/, timestamped. The home directory collapses → the shrink guard pauses saving and warns the user. The home directory grows without bound → the quota pauses saving and warns the user. SIGKILL, no grace period → at most one interval of work is lost. Never more.
